CVE-2025-5683.title: When loading a specifically crafted ICNS format image file in QIm ...
CVE-2025-5683.description:
When loading a specifically crafted ICNS format image file in QImage then it will trigger a crash. 

This issue affects Qt from versions 6.3.0 through 6.5.9, from 6.6.0 through 6.8.4, 6.9.0. This is fixed in 6.5.10, 6.8.5 and 6.9.1.

CVE-2024-30161.title: In Qt 6.5.4, 6.5.5, and 6.6.2, QNetworkReply header data might be ...
CVE-2024-30161.description: In Qt 6.5.4, 6.5.5, and 6.6.2, QNetworkReply header data might be accessed via a dangling pointer in Qt for WebAssembly (wasm). (Earlier and later versions are unaffected.)

CVE-2025-23050.title: QLowEnergyController in Qt before 6.8.2 mishandles malformed Blue ...
CVE-2025-23050.description: QLowEnergyController in Qt before 6.8.2 mishandles malformed Bluetooth ATT commands, leading to an out-of-bounds read (or division by zero). This is fixed in 5.15.19, 6.5.9, and 6.8.2.

CVE-2025-3512.title: There is a Heap-based Buffer Overflow vulnerability in QTextMarkd ...
CVE-2025-3512.description:
There is a Heap-based Buffer Overflow vulnerability in QTextMarkdownImporter. This requires an incorrectly formatted markdown file to be passed to QTextMarkdownImporter to trigger the overflow.

This issue affects Qt from 6.8.0 to 6.8.4. Versions up to 6.6.0 are known to be unaffected, and the fix is in 6.8.4 and later.

CVE-2025-5992.title: When passing values outside of the expected range to QColorTransf ...
CVE-2025-5992.description:
When passing values outside of the expected range to QColorTransferGenericFunction it can cause a denial of service, for example, this can happen when passing a specifically crafted ICC profile to QColorSpace::fromICCProfile.

This issue affects Qt from 6.6.0 through 6.8.3, from 6.9.0 through 6.9.1. This is fixed in 6.8.4 and 6.9.2.

CVE-2026-103653.title: An out-of-bounds read vulnerability in the Qt CoAP message parsin ...
CVE-2026-103653.description: An out-of-bounds read vulnerability in the Qt CoAP message parsing (QCoapInternalReply::createFromFrame()) of the Qt CoAP module. Processing a malformed CoAP message can cause an application using Qt CoAP to crash (loss of availability) or to continue operating on incorrect data (potential loss of integrity).

CVE-2026-105923.title: A malicious SVG can trigger an integer overflow which in turn tri ...
CVE-2026-105923.description: A malicious SVG can trigger an integer overflow which in turn triggers a null-pointer dereference in VectorImage QML Type.

CVE-2026-105946.title: Out-of-bounds read in the QAuthenticator NTLM authentication hand ...
CVE-2026-105946.description: Out-of-bounds read in the QAuthenticator NTLM authentication handling in the Qt Network module in Qt Group Qt allows remote attackers to obtain sensitive information (heap memory contents) or cause a denial of service (application crash) via a crafted NTLM challenge sent by a malicious server or proxy, when an application using QNetworkAccessManager or QTcpSocket authenticates with NTLM.

CVE-2026-107472.title: An out-of-bounds read vulnerability in the QTextCodec TSCII encod ...
CVE-2026-107472.description: An out-of-bounds read vulnerability in the QTextCodec TSCII encoding of the Qt 5 Compatibility APIs module (Qt Core in Qt 5 and earlier) impacts Qt. Applications that convert text to the TSCII encoding through QTextCodec may read memory outside the input buffer, which can cause the application to crash or misinterpret the data.

CVE-2026-107479.title: An integer truncation vulnerability in the QTextCodec conversion  ...
CVE-2026-107479.description: An integer truncation vulnerability in the QTextCodec conversion functions of the Qt 5 Core Compatibility APIs module impacts the Qt Framework. An application using the affected functionality could crash.

CVE-2026-107590.title: An out-of-bounds write vulnerability in the Qt QTextCodec iconv-b ...
CVE-2026-107590.description: An out-of-bounds write vulnerability in the Qt QTextCodec iconv-based encoding of the Qt 5 Compatibility APIs module (Qt Core in Qt 5 and earlier) impacts Qt. Under certain conditions, encoding text with QTextCodec may write outside an internal buffer. This can cause the application to crash and may affect data integrity.

CVE-2026-78253.title: Uncontrolled recursion in QXmlStreamReader::readElementText() in  ...
CVE-2026-78253.description: Uncontrolled recursion in QXmlStreamReader::readElementText() in Qt Group Qt allows attackers to cause a denial of service (application crash via stack exhaustion) via a crafted XML document.

CVE-2026-95620.title: A use-after-free vulnerability in the Qt QNetworkAccessManager HT ...
CVE-2026-95620.description: A use-after-free vulnerability in the Qt QNetworkAccessManager HTTP/2 client support of the Qt Network module allows a malicious or compromised HTTP/2 server to cause the client application to crash, affecting availability.

CVE-2026-96432.title: A malicious or compromised HTTP/2 server withholding SETTINGS ACK ...
CVE-2026-96432.description: A malicious or compromised HTTP/2 server withholding SETTINGS ACK can send RST_STREAM on a completed stream, planting a null pointer, and then send a PUSH_PROMISE for that stream, causing a null pointer dereference in the QNetworkAccessManager class of the Qt Network module that crashes the application.
